Methodology.title: About the data
Methodology.description: Understand dataset content, scope, versions and terms of use before selecting or comparing data.
Methodology.visibilityBody: Dataset pages provide names, versions, scope, sources and available quality information. Indicators show whether published inputs, outputs and impact results can be viewed.
Methodology.comparabilityBody: Compare results only when functional unit, reference flow, method, geography, time, and system boundary are compatible.
Methodology.provenanceBody: Review original sources and field-processing notes on dataset pages. Search interpretations help find records; they are not dataset content.
Methodology.withdrawalBody: Each dataset version has its own link. Withdrawn or restricted content is removed from the catalog.
Methodology.licensingBody: A public catalog entry does not by itself grant permission to reuse the underlying data. Review the source and license for each version; inputs, outputs and impact results have separate availability indicators.
Methodology.searchHelpBody: Describe the product, geography, period and technology you need. Keyword results appear first, followed by an update when description matches are ready. Matches refer to existing catalog datasets; review their details to assess suitability.
Methodology.selectionHelpBody: Save process and flow versions with notes in a shortlist, then export it for backup or transfer. Compare 2–4 process versions to review their scope and methods, and consider system boundaries and study goals before use.

DatabaseGuide.title: Life cycle assessment database
DatabaseGuide.description: Find life cycle inventory (LCI) data in the TianGong catalog and review its scope, sources, versions and licenses.
DatabaseGuide.catalogBody: Life cycle assessment (LCA) uses data on resource consumption, emissions and other inputs and outputs to assess potential environmental impacts across a product or service’s life cycle. The TianGong catalog provides public process and flow records to help you select data for your study.
DatabaseGuide.countsNote: Counts use dataset identifiers; multiple versions of one dataset are counted once. Open a record to see its available versions.
DatabaseGuide.countsUnavailable: Catalog counts are temporarily unavailable. Open the catalog to check the records currently available.
DatabaseGuide.processTitle: Process data: activities and their inputs and outputs
DatabaseGuide.processBody: Process records describe production, energy supply, transport or other activities. Check the reference product, functional unit, geography and time. Exchanges and impact results are available only where the record makes them public.
DatabaseGuide.flowTitle: Flow data: products, resources and emissions
DatabaseGuide.flowBody: Flow records describe the properties and units of products, materials, resources, emissions or waste. They identify process inputs and outputs; a life cycle inventory or carbon footprint requires process data and assessment methods.
DatabaseGuide.selectionTitle: Choose data that fits your study
DatabaseGuide.scopeBody: Check the functional unit, system boundary, production technology and allocation approach. Similar names can describe different activities.
DatabaseGuide.coverageBody: Select data that represents the location and reference period of your study. Read the coverage notes before treating a local sample as an industry average.
DatabaseGuide.evidenceBody: Review original sources, data generators, quality information and documented reviews to assess suitability for your study.
DatabaseGuide.versionBody: Keep the dataset name, exact version and link used in your study. Before comparing results, also check that units, methods and system boundaries are compatible.
DatabaseGuide.accessBody: Browse the catalog without signing in. Before obtaining complete data, check the record and provider’s license for download options and reuse conditions.
DatabaseGuide.distributionBody: The TianGong Life Cycle Data Network (LCDN) is a publication and distribution point for databases in ILCD format, serving LCA software and data networks. Check the node for the datasets, versions and access conditions currently available.
DatabaseGuide.docsBody: Learn to find and use data, build models and interpret environmental impact results.
DatabaseGuide.tidasBody: Understand the data structures, field meanings and exchange rules used in LCA.
DatabaseGuide.pcrBody: Consult product-category requirements for data collection, modelling and quality.
